body: Focus now returns bounded pin summaries with ordered membership from the same projection snapshot. Missing/stale sources retain availability; opening a card still reads its current source before editing. Reference-only hosts remain supported. At 1,000 cards/ten pins, warm constrained Focus falls from 935.4 to 523.5 ms (44%); fresh Focus falls from 1,220.9 to 806.6 ms. Five quiet release samples, synthetic projects and phone/network emulation; no physical-device or p95 acceptance claimed. Full gate: 239 Rust, 112 JavaScript and 12 Python tests. Affected Chromium/WebKit and final broad HTTPS checks pass. Safari focus restoration is fixed; the persistence test waits for the post-write read before reload. An isolated initial Board editor click failure did not recur; its cause remains unknown. The manual app is rebuilt/restarted and HTTPS assets verified; all 25 existing resource versions, two pins, preferences and certificate are preserved. Evidence: progress/2026-09-29-performance-optimization.md and ADR-051. Further transfer/rendering and durable creation performance remain open; scope, card status and acceptance are unchanged.

metadata.summary: Focus startup avoids per-pin reads and preserves older-host compatibility
